Seer.directive_rationale: When the village questioned the mechanics, you should have pivoted from listing 'clears' to explaining the rules.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Seer (Nhan) was eliminated in Round 1 and did not participate in any debate phases.

Guard.directive_rationale: You must understand that 'no deaths' can be caused by either the Guard or the Witch.
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard (Cong) was eliminated in Round 2 before the first 'no deaths' night occurred in Round 3.

Guard.directive_rationale: By calling the Witch a liar, you created a fake contradiction that the wolves exploited.
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard (Cong) was eliminated in Round 2 and was not present for the Round 3 debate.

Villager.directive_rationale: In this game, if a Witch uses a save potion on a target the wolves attacked, no one dies.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Villagers Jin, Hoang, and Meg reacted differently: Jin accepted the claim and voted Riley; Hoang and Meg rejected the claim as a wolf tactic and voted Nam.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin followed the directive by trusting Nam's save claim, but Hoang and Meg ignored it, treating the claim as a wolf signal.

Villager.directive_rationale: When the Seer cleared the Guard, you should have trusted that data regardless of your personal feelings toward the Seer's tone.
Villager.verdict_notes: The Seer (Nhan) was eliminated before they could reveal the clearance of the Guard (Cong) to the village.

Villager.directive_rationale: Never prioritize 'vibes' or perceived 'urgency' over a Seer's confirmed clearance.
Villager.verdict_notes: The Seer never provided a confirmed clearance to the public record.
